brief: How to launch a brand in 7 days — the no-BS playbook.

slots.title: NAIL YOUR NICHE
slots.body: Stop guessing. Pick one problem you solve better than anyone else and own it. If you try to serve everyone, you end up helping no one.

slots.title: CRAFT THE VIBE
slots.body: Your name, logo, and colors matter, but don’t overthink them. Use a simple template and move on. Perfect is the enemy of launched.

slots.title: BUILD YOUR HUB
slots.body: You need one place to send traffic. Whip up a one-page site with a clear headline and a signup button. Keep it clean and fast.

slots.title: BATCH YOUR CONTENT
slots.body: Film and write three days of posts in one sitting. Batch your captions, hooks, and graphics so you’re not scrambling daily. Consistency beats perfection.

slots.title: SET UP SALES
slots.body: Hook up a payment link and an email welcome sequence. If people can’t buy or sign up, you don’t have a business. Test the flow twice.

slots.title: LAUNCH IT LOUD
slots.body: Announce everywhere you hang out. Post the story, send the email, and ask three friends to share. Done beats perfect every single time.
